description:
A dispatch build of core site-inputs.yml already requires a successful trunk.yml push run on CORE_SHA (site-inputs.yml lines 108-111) and then writes certified_by=dispatch (line 114). The site refuses that value ("certified_by dispatch is not a run id", scripts/bundle-verify.mjs:34-35), so the one documented recovery produces an undeployable bundle (core run 38392104307, site Deploy 38392445519).

Fix at the producer: record the numeric id of the Trunk run it already found. Do not relax the site gate. The site's check (bundle-verify.mjs:23-27) verifies the run path, event, branch, conclusion and head_sha independently; accepting an unverifiable "dispatch" value would weaken it, reopen D-O1/D-O2 and the item site-split-55 tightening decision, and needs an owner decision. site-inputs.yml and scripts/site_inputs.py are soundness paths: oracle review applies.
